title: Continuous integral and rational coefficient pullback for arbitrary morphisms
statement: Let ell be prime and E/Q_ell a finite field extension. Equip E with its canonical spectral norm and A=O_E with the induced topology. For every morphism h:Z→X of schemes, continuous precomposition gives isomorphisms h^{-1}A_X→A_Z and h^{-1}E_X→E_Z, where B_X(V)=C(|V|,B). These are the canonical adjoints of precomposition on base-changed pro-etale tests. Integral precomposition commutes with reduction modulo each positive uniformizer power and with A→E. Maps into A_X are determined by all these reduction projections. These constructions use the coefficient conventions of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction].

source.place: Lemmas 4.2.12, 6.5.9, 6.5.11, 6.8.2 and Remark 6.8.15; the corresponding step of lem-weil-pbc-realization-localized-push

proof.text:
The finite constant quotient tower is preserved by inverse image, and
its limit is the continuous integral coefficient sheaf. Projectionwise reduction
identifies its comparison with the canonical pullback. To obtain a rational
inverse, pull back integral inclusion through the integral inverse. Constants
show that this map inverts the uniformizer. The localization universal property
extends it uniquely to rational coefficients. Naturality of inclusion and
uniqueness on integral numerators prove the two inverse equations.
